evidenceLimits: Partial scans use a one-call wrapper around native measureStructure, not a genuine oversized engine-limit scan.
Inventory lesson exclusion uses one natively placed mesh explicitly marked as lesson-owned; no authored lesson is loaded.
Contrast is activated on the harness document ancestor, matching the production CSS contract; host theme switching is not exercised.

Fixture state explicitly enables coordinates and seeds protected learner drafts/reflection; panel navigation uses the existing React state bridge while form controls, disclosure, scrolling, and close actions use the UI.
